note: Central harness configuration. 'level' is one of: off | warn | block. 'block' fails the gate (and blocks the commit); 'warn' prints a reminder but does not fail; 'off' skips the check.

tempCleanup.note: True scratch paths. (.understand-anything working files are managed by the understand skill, not listed here.) When any exists with content, the gate reminds you to launch the temp-janitor subagent (which confirms before deleting) or run `npm run clean:temp -- --apply`.

handoff.note: Tracked (NOT gitignored) handoff doc. Run /handoff, then capture the result into this file so the next session/agent can continue. The gate reminds when a commit does not update it.

understandMap.note: Codebase map produced by /understand-anything:understand. The structure judge and reviewers compare the live codebase against docs/APP-STRUCTURE.md using this. The gate reminds you to rebuild it when application source changes.

guard.note: Used by .claude/hooks/pre-edit-guard.mjs. 'deny' edits are refused; 'ask' edits trigger a user-confirmation prompt (native Claude Code permission ask); 'warn' edits are allowed with a note. Patterns: trailing '/' = directory, '*.ext' = extension, else exact filename / path suffix.
